req-01.fix: Protect both coercions locally with Result.try and a stable fallback, preserving successful descriptions and the original cause. Reuse the GraphQL conversion pattern without requiring edits to GraphQL.ts. Add uncoercible-object and array regressions in GitHubError.test.ts.

req-02.summary: Let scope cleanup terminate a blocked token rotation
req-02.fix: Track and stop in-flight rotation before final cleanup; interrupt and join its fiber, then revoke the owned token without waiting behind an unbounded permit holder. Preserve refresh serialization and atomic ownership updates. Add a scope-close-while-refresh-is-blocked regression in GitHubApp.test.ts that proves abort, completion and correct revocation.

req-03.summary: Decode issue comments before marker matching and construction
req-03.fix: Validate each inspected body's string shape before matching, retaining nullish-body normalization and upstream short-circuit search; decode the selected and created CommentRecord effectfully and map failures to GitHubError.decode. Do not eagerly decode/traverse the entire tail after a match or reintroduce the eager map removed in round 2. Add malformed-body/id/URL and early-match regressions in GitHubIssue.coverage.test.ts.

req-04.summary: Decode issue projections and label shapes in the typed channel
req-04.fix: Decode the selected wire fields before unsafe label access and decode IssueInfo effectfully, mapping failures to the calling operation's GitHubError.decode. Preserve valid label omission, state normalization and ordering; use effectful list traversal. Add fractional-number/null-label/null-name regressions in GitHubIssue.coverage.test.ts.

req-05.summary: Decode check-run references instead of throwing
req-05.fix: Make refOf an effectful decoder of validated selected fields and map errors to GitHubError.decode for create/get. Preserve numeric-id normalization and valid defaults; cover fractional ids and wrong-type fields in CheckRun.coverage.test.ts.

req-06.fix: Decode ReleaseInfo and ReleaseAsset effectfully with operation-specific GitHubError.decode mapping; validate selected wire shapes before unsafe access and use effectful traversal. Preserve uploadAsset's validated response path and valid defaults/order. Add invalid release-id/boolean and asset-size cases in GitHubRelease.coverage.test.ts.

req-07.summary: Decode commit summaries and comparison models
req-07.fix: Decode the selected summary and comparison shapes effectfully, mapping errors to GitHubError.decode for get/list/compare, including compare's embedded commits. Validate nested wire access, preserve optional-field semantics and fileOf, and use effectful traversal. Add message/login/status/count regressions in GitHubCommit.coverage.test.ts.

req-08.summary: Decode GitHub App responses before dereferencing
req-08.fix: Decode selected wire response shapes before nested access, then decode Installation/AppIdentity/InstallationToken effectfully and map failures to the existing installation/identity/token GitHubAppError kinds. Preserve valid defaults, fallback behavior and order. Add null-token and invalid installation/identity/bot fields to GitHubApp.test.ts.

req-09.summary: Decode environment list results without synchronous throws
req-09.fix: Validate each selected environment wire shape and decode DeploymentEnvironmentInfo effectfully with GitHubError.decode('DeploymentEnvironment.list', ...). Preserve valid result representation and order; add wrong-type-name regression in DeploymentEnvironment.test.ts. Central codemod records the forced validation change.

req-10.fix: Decode selected wire fields, including tree and parent SHA shapes, before projection; decode CommitRef effectfully and map failures to GitHubError.decode('GitCommit.get', ...). Add malformed-parent and missing-nested-object cases in GitCommit.coverage.test.ts.

req-11.summary: Validate branch ref SHA before returning typed success
req-11.fix: Decode {object:{sha:S.String}} inside readRef and map errors to GitHubError.decode(operation, ...), preserving notFound recovery. Add wrong-type SHA and missing-object regressions for sha/shaOption/exists in GitBranch.test.ts.

req-12.summary: Validate base64 file content before string operations
req-12.fix: Validate the outer response before property access and the base64 branch's content as a string before replace. Map malformed data to GitHubError.decode while preserving existing directory/non-file/unsupported-encoding rejection behavior. Add null/omitted/wrong-type content cases through both file APIs in GitHubContent.coverage.test.ts.

req-13.summary: Traverse older issue cross-reference timeline pages
req-13.fix: Add pageInfo and a before cursor to the owned query/schema and walk previous pages until a match or exhaustion. Preserve the CROSS_REFERENCED_EVENT filter and early match. Add a preceding-page match regression in GitHubIssue.coverage.test.ts.

req-14.fix: Use existing client pagination machinery for this route and owned ListResponse/entry decoding before projection. Preserve API-version headers, predicate filter, document order and initial notFound/422 empty-list recovery. Add a two-page Link/cursor regression in Attestation.coverage.test.ts; keep shared pagination helpers read-only.

req-15.summary: Preserve own permission keys during normalization
req-15.fix: Filter entries to string values and build the permission record with R.fromEntries so every accepted key becomes an own property. Add an own '__proto__' plus ordinary-grant regression through token normalization in GitHubApp.test.ts.

req-16.summary: Own an observed minted credential before interruptible postprocessing
req-16.fix: Separate interruptible mint HTTP from masked ownership transfer of a returned raw credential, registering cleanup before interruptible decoding/client construction. Track a revocable observed token even if decoding or construction does not finish. Keep stalled HTTP abortable and do not claim revocation of a token never observed by the client. Add a deterministic cancellation-after-response regression in GitHubApp.test.ts proving observed-token revocation.

req-17.summary: Reject invalid rate-limit snapshots without discarding responses
req-17.fix: In internal/octokit.ts record, validate the complete parsed snapshot nonthrowingly against RateLimitSnapshot. Leave the previous Ref value unchanged and succeed with void when invalid; update it only with a valid snapshot. Keep header parsing, retry-delay saturation and classification intact. Add complete-triple unsafe-integer/overflow REST, pagination and GraphQL regressions in transport.test.ts and internal/octokit.coverage.test.ts, including prior-snapshot retention. No headers.ts or Resilience.ts edit is needed.

req-18.summary: Decode latest-semver candidates before fallible access
req-18.fix: Validate the entry's string name before prefix/extraction, preserve prefix/non-version/prerelease short-circuit skips, and validate nested commit SHA for selected candidates before effectful SemverTag decoding. Map validation failures to GitHubError.decode('GitTag.latestSemver', ...), retaining one-pass selection and valid ordering. Add wrong-name/null-SHA/missing-commit typed-failure cases in GitTag.test.ts; do not force SHA validation on candidates the upstream algorithm skips.

req-19.summary: Normalize tag upsert creation exactly once
req-19.fix: Pass the original tag to create and retain the once-normalized short for reset. Add successful-create and already-exists-fallback regressions with tags/tags/foo in GitTag.test.ts.

req-20.summary: Exclude undefined settings from writes and applied-key reports
req-20.fix: Skip undefined-valued entries before routing or recording their keys, preserving false, null and explicitly supplied values. Add REST-only and GraphQL-only undefined-input regressions asserting empty reports and zero HTTP requests in GitHubRepository.test.ts.

req-21.summary: Validate nested tag records before the existing list decoder
req-21.fix: Decode the selected page-element wire shape before nested access, then feed validated fields into the existing TagRef decoder and error mapping. Preserve list's existing decode-before-prefix behavior and ordering. Add null/missing-commit typed-failure cases in GitTag.test.ts.
